composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Show a porcelain kingfisher perched on a short white ceramic post, its long pointed bill balancing a compact rounded body. Use deep teal glaze on the back, muted apricot on the chest, and a single precise dark eye. Keep the wing planes smooth and clearly separated, with subtle kiln pooling near the feet. Light it softly against misty mint, emphasizing crisp ceramic edges and the alert sideways turn of its head. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
